children.text: The Lonely Villa and Suspense is an AVAnnotate project that explores how suspense is created through audiovisual form in D. W. Griffith’s 1909 film The Lonely Villa. Using time-based annotations, the project draws attention to specific moments in the film and examines how techniques such as editing, pacing, performance, framing, and music contribute to the development of tension. Rather than simply presenting the film, the project uses annotation to encourage close audiovisual analysis, allowing viewers to move between the film itself and commentary on how suspense is constructed.
